mission: Process the emotional weight of the Jacen/GAG history with Desh honestly enough to enable the trust the mission requires.
why_now: The emotional weight of the Ben/Desh shared history has been building since Chapter 1. The outpost visit — humanizing the Brotherhood — has created the opening for honest reckoning.
conflict: Ben vs. his own suppressed history — internal reckoning
turning_point: Ben and Desh acknowledge Jacen and GAG honestly for the first time. The emotional groundwork for pattern recognition is laid.
emotional_trajectory: Acknowledgment — not resolution, not forgiveness — is the precondition for trust
notes: Two pivotal conversations. Ben and Desh acknowledge Jacen and GAG honestly for the first time. Kael and Desh form genuine connection. Honesty laid as groundwork for trust.
